newsitem.title: USA: Amax Gold Inc names Leland Erdahl CFO.
newsitem.headline: Amax Gold Inc names Leland Erdahl CFO.

text.p: Amax Gold Inc said Monday that it named Leland Erdahl as vice president and chief financial officer, filling an existing vacancy.
Erdahl, 68, most recently was president and chief executive of Stolar Inc and Albuquerque Uranium Corp.
Former CFO Mark Lettes stepped down in August to take the position of vice president of trading.
Amax said he has served in senior finance, treasury and executive positions for various major mining companies.
Amax Gold Inc is 52.5 percent owned by Cyprus Amax Minerals Co.
Amax Gold produces gold in the U.S. and Chile, and explores for gold principally in the Americas, Russia, Australia and Africa.
